lessons.title: Classical Conditioning: Pavlovian Associations
lessons.description: Master unconditioned/conditioned stimuli, acquisition, extinction, spontaneous recovery, and taste aversion.

lessons.title: Operant Conditioning: Reinforcement & Punishment
lessons.description: Understand Thorndike's Law of Effect, the 2x2 grid of positive/negative reinforcement and punishment, and shaping.

lessons.title: Schedules of Reinforcement & Behavior Modification
lessons.description: Analyze Fixed/Variable Ratio and Interval schedules, resistance to extinction, and token economies.

lessons.title: Observational Learning & Cognitive Factors in Learning
lessons.description: Explore Bandura's Bobo Doll study, mirror neurons, latent learning, and cognitive maps.
